# Interacting common-loss reservoirs: acquired sector compiler

31 October 2026. Whole receiving candidate for independent review. This is not an implementation, practical advantage or novelty claim. The precursor `TOTAL_EXCITATION_COMPILER_OPENING.md` remains frozen; its missing explicit Dyson phase is superseded here by (-i)^V for every retained virtual interaction insertion.

## 1. Model, compatibility and paid access

Let N=sum_i a_i^dagger a_i on r bosonic mode registers. The initial reservoir is vacuum. Define

    R_plus=sum_i F_i a_i^dagger, g=sqrt(sum_i f_i^2),
    H=H_f+R_plus+R_plus^dagger, J_i=2sqrt(lambda)a_i,

where lambda>0 is COMMON to all modes and each bounded system-only F_i has a supplied controlled block encoding of normalization f_i>=||F_i||. Their actual selection and precision costs are paid. Different F_i need not commute.

H_f is a compatible selfadjoint direct sum over total-excitation sectors, with [H_f,N]=0. Its restrictions to N<=L agree when L increases; unrelated matrices at different cutoffs are not admissible. Each finite restriction is bounded. A certified bound a_f(L)>=||H_f|_(N<=L)|| and an actual controlled implementation of exp(-it H_f) on that subspace, to any required precision, must be supplied or acquired. Denote its real cost by C_f(L,t,delta). No generic fast-forwarding or exponentially large matrix access is granted.

All physical modes remain in the model even if some F_i=0: H_f may move excitations into those modes and they can emit. Zero coefficients are omitted only from the coupling stack. If g=0 globally, N remains0 and the problem is the supplied H_f|_(N=0) evolution with system controls, not an immigration bridge.

Controls are normal system-only instruments at p prescribed times; arbitrary references and their outcome records are retained. They commute with N. Reservoir states, emission colors and private clocks remain inaccessible to the consumer. Instrument implementation costs are external or added separately.

Use a GLOBAL cutoff N<=L, not separate mode cutoffs as a dynamical boundary. Digital registers may each hold0..L; a coherent sum/predicate marks the valid total-number subspace. Define every arithmetic/unitary routine on the rest of the digital register as an explicit unitary extension or CPTP fallback. No good block normalizes an invalid branch.

# Excitation-preserving lossy qubit registers: explicit candidate interface
31 October 2026. Root corollary candidate; depends on the not-yet-reviewed whole graded compiler.

## Physical model
Take r private qubits initially |0...0>, n_i=|1><1|_i, N=sum n_i, and sigma_i^-=|0><1|_i. The system-register free Hamiltonian H_f commutes with N. Examples include system drift, known diagonal excitation interactions n_i n_j, and number-conserving XY exchange. The couplings are

    R_plus=sum_i F_i sigma_i^+,
    J_i=2sqrt(lambda) sigma_i^-.

Every F_i is system-only with supplied controlled block encoding, accessible normalization f_i, and paid adjoint/selection cost. Set g^2=sum f_i^2, Gamma=g^2/lambda. Neither a Gaussian bath nor harmonic-oscillator CCR is assumed. Unknown H_f remains expensive if its actual controlled evolution is expensive.

## Earned removal and raising maps
On a bitstring x with Hamming weight n>0, coherently prepare a color i uniformly over its n occupied bits, then erase that bit:

    V_minus |x> =sum_{i:x_i=1} |i>|x-e_i>/sqrt(n).

Distinct input strings have orthogonal output supports because (i,post-string) uniquely reconstructs the original string. This is an isometry on N>0 and can be implemented with polynomial-in-r reversible population-count and controlled state-preparation arithmetic. Vacuum is flagged separately. Its inverse unitary supplies the adjoint block. The color is retained for physical emissions.

Prepare the system stack W/g=sum_i |i>F_i/g by amplitudes f_i/g and the supplied controlled F_i/f_i blocks, retaining i. Since sum F_i^dagger F_i<=g^2I, this is an acquired contraction. Applying V_minus^dagger after that stack on an n-excitation string gives

    O_plus|H_n=R_plus/[g sqrt(n+1)].

If i was already occupied, the corresponding proposed insertion lies outside the image of V_minus and contributes zero. This implements hard-core exclusion rather than pretending sigma_i^+ is bosonic. Hence R_plus R_plus^dagger<=g^2N follows, and the stacked physical jump is 2sqrt(lambda) V_minus sqrt(N), with no gratuitous sqrt(r) normalization.

## Interface with the abstract scalar bridge
The no-jump decay is -2lambda N. Since H_f preserves N, its propagation is the scalar decay on each total-excitation sector times the paid H_f unitary. Every interaction insertion changes total excitation by one and is bounded/encoded by g sqrt(n+1)
